Name: Custom JLCPCB PCB
Purpose: A custom pcb connecting parts together.

Name: Raspberry Pi Pico W
Purpose: Microcontroller, the brain of the synthesizer.

Name: GY-PCM5102 I2S audio module
Purpose: Audio generator, wich then passes audio to the amplifier

Name: Diode 1N5822
Purpose: Diode for reverse battery protection. 10 is minimum quantity.

Name: Button, 6 x 6 x 6 mm
Purpose: Button for changing things in menu.

Name: 5×20 GLASS QUICK BLOW FUSE 3A
Purpose: Fast blow fuse for safety in the pcb.

Name: 5×20mm fuse holder, PCB THT
Purpose: Fuse holder. Holds the fuse, 20 is the minimum quantity.

Name: POT 10kΩ Through Hole
Purpose: Potenciometer for the knobs in the synthesizer. Used to control value and settings.

Name: JST S2B-PH-K-S
Purpose: The jst pin for battery. 20 is the minimum quantity

Name: MICROCHIP MCP3208-CI/P
Purpose: analog multiplexer to read potencimeters, because pico does not have enough adc pins

Name: 2.54mm 16P DIP Tin Square Hole 7.62mm DIP-16 IC Sockets RoHS
Purpose: Holder for the MCP3208 chip. 10 is the minimum quantity on lcsc.

Name: Digital audio amplifier PAM8403 - 2 x 3W
Purpose: To amplify the sound generated by the PCM5102A for speakers

Name: IIC I2C OLED displej 1,3" - White, 128 x 64
Purpose: Oled display for vizualization of the sound and values. Allows the user to see what vaues he is setting and what mode is he on.
